TRUMP.title: The Donald
TRUMP.description:
A tremendous businessman. The best, many people are saying.
Builds walls, makes deals, sends the Spire's riff-raff packing.
TRUMP.cardsModifierDescription: The Donald cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
TRUMP.eventDeathPrevention: Nobody quits like me. I never quit. Never.
TRUMP.goldMonologue: [sine]Beautiful gold. The best gold. Somebody else will pay for the wall anyway...[/sine]
TRUMP.aromaPrinciple: [sine][gold]We're going to climb this Spire, and it's going to be huge.[/gold][/sine]
TRUMP.banter.alive.endTurnPing: Let's go, let's go. Time is money.
TRUMP.unlockText: Play a run as {Prerequisite} to unlock.
